objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, versioned, archived, invalidated, reactivated and translated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected type of the document, such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction or work instruction.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to structure document types.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Default name composed of document type abbreviation, consecutive number per type and title.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive four-digit number per type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version metadata that can be printed in a template-based document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status metadata that can be printed in a template-based document and used in workflows.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope metadata that can be printed in a template-based document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity is counted after release.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate when validity extension is necessary.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which invalidated documents are archived before physical deletion.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: Original language version used before translation.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: External file or document that can be uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted PDF displayed on the web after saving a document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and automatically released with the main document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person or system user acting as creator, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, initiator, editor, applicant or workflow participant.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role or document-specific role such as reader, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, initiator or editor.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users assigned for authorizations, reader access, distribution or role selection.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system to assign read and change rights to users or persons for each document.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned in workflow-supported approval, validity extension, override, reactivation or acknowledgement processing.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete release-process tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to involved users about workflow tasks, releases, change proposals, validity extension, override or distribution.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for a document that can be created and managed without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked when validity is close to expiry.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created for a document that must be invalidated and archived.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document with user groups or persons for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation of acknowledgement requested from distribution recipients and documented without a signature.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard populated with documents according to distribution groups.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process that can be automatically linked with documents already in the system.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit that can be automatically linked with documents already in the system.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk that can be automatically linked with documents already in the system.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data that can be automatically linked with documents already in the system.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: IT application referenced as master data or maintained as an attribute for linking documents.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system for which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Language-dependent version of released document content that must be checked and released.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one of the templates defined for the document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload an external file or document to a pure object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate a new document based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document after editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF with system support.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display the converted current version on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign participants in the release process via document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Add additional information to a document by attaching a new information object.

evts.name: release_additional_information
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in its properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled attachment to a document by attaching a new information object.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment and thereby trigger a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step release process after document creation, metadata and content maintenance and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the creator step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser positively completes release to finally release the document.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Reject during review or release, causing workflow cancellation for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a valid released document is revised or certain changes occur.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a validity extension request 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request for validity extension, and update document validity.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a revised version is released or override is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Create a request for override for a selected document.

evts.name: process_request_for_override
evts.description: Process a request for override with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare a document and its attachments invalid and archive them.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Revoke all rights except for the archive group when archiving a document.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: process_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Automatically start and complete the reactivation workflow.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new version of an invalidated document, restore metadata, authorizations, distribution list, and reactivate archived attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain distribution lists for each document by assigning user groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request recipients by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of the relevant document without a signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notify the author team when all persons maintained in distribution have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: populate_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Run role-specific evaluation reports and searches for documents in the system.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible in a multi-client system.

evts.name: create_local_addition_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition to another document.

evts.name: create_reference_to_document
evts.description: Create a reference from a local addition document to the original document.

o2o.description: One or more templates can be defined for each document type and selected for documents.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.
Saved documents are converted to PDF and the current version is displayed on the web.
Additional information can be added to each document and is associated with the document.
Attachments are associated with the main document and released with it.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for override is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
User groups can be assigned to the distribution list.
Persons can be assigned to the distribution list.
User groups contain users.
Authorization groups assign read and change rights to a group of users or persons.
Authorization groups are assigned specifically to documents.
Readers, authors, co-authors, reviewers, releasers and translators are assigned to documents via attributes.
Reader user groups and distribution user groups are assigned to documents.
Signatures of individual participants are documented in the system for each released version.
Acknowledgements are documented and summarized for document authors or other key roles.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with master data.
IT applications are given as an example of master data.
IT applications can be maintained through document properties to link documents.
Documents can be linked or referenced with other documents.
Documents assigned through distribution are listed in role-specific dashboards.
Reports and searches evaluate documents stored in the system.
Released document content can have language-dependent versions.
For each document in a multi-client system, visible clients can be specified.
Participants for checking and releasing the translation are assigned in document properties.
